assertion: Under the current kiso shell execution model, an external SIGKILL of the AGENT process group does not sever an effect the agent already started — the effect survives to completion (so the 'effect dies with the agent' world does not occur without explicit coupling).

support.note: both C2 mini-rerun runs: effect survived the agent-group kill (end row present)

validity.activeWhile: the shell tool spawns effects detached with their own process group
